import requests

def get_ncbi_summary(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    gene_id = res['esearchresult']['idlist'][0]
    sum_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    sum_res = requests.get(sum_url).json()
    return sum_res['result'][gene_id]

upb1_ncbi = get_ncbi_summary("UPB1")
ndufs8_ncbi = get_ncbi_summary("NDUFS8")
print("UPB1 NCBI:", upb1_ncbi.get('name'), upb1_ncbi.get('description'))
print("NDUFS8 NCBI:", ndufs8_ncbi.get('name'), ndufs8_ncbi.get('description'))

def get_refseq_len(term):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=protein&term={term}&retmode=json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    id_list = res['esearchresult']['idlist']
    sum_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={id_list[0]}&retmode=json"
    sum_res = requests.get(sum_url).json()
    return sum_res['result'][id_list[0]]['slen']
